stepBody: Parth decided to not use any of the previous strategies. He instead decides to get help from his fellow TAs Rohil, Kunal, Kelly, and Andrew who are all creating their own models! He tells them that instead of making their own models, they can just team up and average all the predictions from each individual model. How does the bias and variance of this new model generally change compared to Parth's individual model? Assume that all models are well validated. Select all that apply.
